groupbar {
        # Font settings
        font_family = "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"
        font_size = 10
        
        # Colors
        col.active = $mauve
        col.inactive = $surface1
        
        # Text colors (Requires Hyprland v0.42.0+)
        text_color = $text
        
        # Appearance
        gradients = true
        render_titles = true
        height = 14
        stacked = false # Set to true for a vertical stack
    }

# keybinds related to groups
bind = SUPER, G, togglegroup

# Toggle a window into/out of a group
bind = SUPER, G, togglegroup

# Navigation (Switch between tabs/windows in the group)
bind = SUPER, TAB, changegroupactive, f # forward
bind = SUPER_SHIFT, TAB, changegroupactive, b # backward

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Workspace-Rules
# --------------------------------------------------------
windowrule = workspace 1,match:class ^(kitty)$
windowrule = workspace 2,match:class ^(zen|brave-browser|google-chrome)$
windowrule = workspace 3,match:class ^(cursor|neovide)$
windowrule = workspace 4,match:class ^(spotify|obsidian)$
windowrule = workspace 5,match:class ^(discord)$
windowrule = workspace 6,match:class ^(pcmanfm)$

# █░█░█ █ █▄░█ █▀▄ █▀█ █░█░█   █▀█ █░█ █░░ █▀▀ █▀

windowrule = float true, center true, size 900 500,match:class blueman-manager
windowrule = float true, center true, size 900 500,match:title ^(Network Connections)$
windowrule = float true, center true, size 900 600,match:title ^(Volume Control)$
windowrule = float true, center true, size 800 600,match:title ^(Waypaper)$

# --------------------------------------------------------
# Common Dialog Windows
# --------------------------------------------------------
windowrule = float true, center true, size 700 500,match:title ^(Open.*Files?|Save.*Files?|All Files|Save)$
windowrule = float true, center true, size 700 500,match:title ^(Save).*$
# Rename dialogs
windowrule = float true, center true, size 350 100,match:title ^(Rename|Move).*$

# Generic dialog windows
windowrule = float true, center true,match:class ^(.*)[Dd]ialog(.*)$

# common modals
windowrule = float true,match:title ^(Confirm to replace files)$
windowrule = float true,match:title ^(File Operation Progress)$
windowrule = float true,match:class ^(xdg-desktop-portal-gtk)$
windowrule = float true,match:class ^(xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland)$
windowrule = float true, match:title ^(branchdialog)$
windowrule = float true, center true,size 622 652, match:class clipse
windowrule = persistent_size on,suppress_event maximize, match:class .*

{
